name: binding-states-no-slots-declared-diverges-from-all-unbound
description: A document declaring no slots at all, sharing the same shape/entities/window as binding-states-all-unbound-retained, mints a different id from that all-unbound sibling.
notes: Pins the divergence binding-states-all-unbound-retained's notes describe: a shape carrying two declared-but-unbound slots and a shape carrying none are different identities, so their ids differ even though both projections carry an empty or two-entry slots array over otherwise identical shape/entities/window.
